import numpy as np
U=0.022/0.12+0.03 # ~0.21 W/m2K
A=24 # 2.2x2.0x2.1m chamber
dT=38
Q_trans=U*A*dT
Q_resp=0.05*1000 # 50 mW/kg at 5C mixed produce
Q_door=70 # strip curtain + 8 openings/day avg
Q_fan=40
Q_total=Q_trans+Q_resp+Q_door+Q_fan
print(f"U={U:.2f} Q_trans={Q_trans:.0f} W Q_total={Q_total:.0f} W daily={(Q_total*24/1000):.1f} kWh")
# staged: 250 kg/day from 30 to 5C over 24h adds average:
Q_pull_avg=250*3600*25/86400
print(f"250kg/day avg pull power={Q_pull_avg:.0f} W energy=6.2 kWh")
print(f"total avg with pull={(Q_total+Q_pull_avg):.0f} W")
# lumped pull of 250kg batch with 800W cool
C=250*3600
T0=30; Tset=5; dt=300; T=T0; t=0
Q_cool=750
while T>Tset and t<48*3600:
  T+=(Q_total*250/1000+Q_resp*0.25-Q_cool)*dt/C  # approx share
  # simplified constant
  t+=dt
print(f"250kg batch pull time {t/3600:.1f} h")
